meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆给多个子代理并行执行,并留下执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一份写好的工作计划,想让它被自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan across parallel subagents and keep an evidence log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want it executed for you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不再自己写代码或改产品文件,而是充当编排者:选计划、把勾选项拆成原子子任务、并行派发子代理并盯到完成,同时记录 Boulder 状态与证据账本,直到计划勾选框全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-execute”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划文件时接管;若没有可用计划,会先引导生成一份计划再开始执行。

say.note: 从该计划第一个未完成勾选项开始执行
第一阶段复用已有 worktree
开 PR、盯 CI,合并后清理 worktree

howto.what_en: After install, Claude stops writing code or editing product files itself and acts as orchestrator: it picks a plan, splits checkboxes into atomic sub-tasks, dispatches parallel subagents, watches each to completion, and records Boulder state plus an evidence ledger until every plan checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "ulw-execute" or ask it to run a plan file under .omo/plans. If no runnable plan exists, it first bootstraps an approved plan, then starts execution.

say_en.note: Starts from the first unchecked item
Opens a PR, watches CI, cleans up after merge
